schema.description: One result per domain, in the order sent

status.description: `ok` when the test file came back, `wrong-data` when the domain answered 200 with something else, `404` when it answered not found, `no-host` when the domain does not resolve, `failed` when the outside service could not be asked, or `other:` followed by another status code or the service's message

description:
Checks that each domain reaches this instance over HTTP on port 80, as the HTTP challenge needs: it writes a test file and asks an outside service (site24x7) to fetch it. The answer lists one result per domain; a domain that fails does not fail the request.
Needs: Certificates manage
